wordsWhy: These words are the only way to open your messages on a new phone or computer. {name} never sees them, and nobody can make them again for you. Lose them and you can still log in, but every old message is gone. Someone else who has them can read your messages and join as a new device.
wordsLead: Write these down. They are shown once.
wrongWords: Those are not this account's words.
